categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in precision metal components manufacturing, serving sectors including 3C (computer, communication, consumer electronics), automotive, electric tools, and photovoltaic diamond wire busbars. Its product portfolio includes precision springs, stamped parts, metal injection molded parts, turned parts, connectors, sunroof drive tubes, and assembly components. The company also engages in research and production of diamond wire busbars mainly for the photovoltaic industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced precision metal forming technologies such as fine wire forming, high-precision turning and milling, metal insert injection molding, metal powder injection molding (MIM), high-speed continuous stamping, 3D tube bending, and micron-level metal wet drawing. It has developed 13 core technologies including high-precision shaped spring forming, fatigue-resistant spring forming and testing, high-precision large-tonnage stamping, metal injection molding control, and high-precision diamond micro-busbar drawing. The company also emphasizes automation and intelligent manufacturing upgrades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in consumer electronics, automotive, electric tools, and photovoltaic sectors, including well-known companies like Foxconn, Makita, Stanley Black & Decker, Bosch, Webasto, and Inalfa. The company serves global markets with a focus on China and exports primarily through bonded zones. Its products are used in smartphones, PCs, wearable devices, automotive components (including new energy vehicles), electric tools, and photovoltaic silicon wafer cutting.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Kunshan and Nantong, Jiangsu Province. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and exports products internationally, mainly through bonded zones. Its customer base includes multinational corporations with global supply chains, serving markets in North America, Europe, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer and supplier of precision metal components within the supply chain. It provides customized precision parts to downstream original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in various industries. It also engages in upstream activities such as producing brass wire rods for its photovoltaic diamond wire busbar business, indicating some vertical integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on intelligent manufacturing upgrades and independent development of new materials. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 9.53% revenue allocation in 2024, and has a large R&D team of over 500 personnel. Key R&D projects include advanced forming processes, high-stability elastic materials, electrochemical machining, automated assembly and testing technologies, and new materials for photovoltaic and automotive applications. The company is also expanding into the humanoid robot components market, leveraging its precision metal manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized precision metal components to industrial customers. The company follows a direct sales model with orders based on customer contracts and forecasts. It also generates income from government subsidies and investment income. The company has issued convertible bonds to raise capital, reflecting financing activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a high-tech leader in precision metal components manufacturing with strong R&D capabilities and advanced manufacturing technologies. It competes with domestic and international suppliers in the 3C, automotive, electric tools, and photovoltaic sectors. It has established long-term partnerships with major global OEMs, enhancing its competitive position. The company is recognized for its quality, technological innovation, and supply chain reliability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.285 billion, a 29.6% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 54.53 million, a decrease of 38.38%. Total assets reached RMB 3.57 billion, up 7.19% from the previous year. The company has experienced growth in 3C, automotive, and electric tool segments, while photovoltaic business declined due to industry conditions. It maintains a stable equity base and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, stable quality, and high yield rates in its customized metal components, supported by advanced manufacturing technologies and strong R&D. It offers integrated solutions including design collaboration, process optimization, and cost control, enhancing customer responsiveness. Its vertical integration in photovoltaic materials and expansion into emerging markets like humanoid robot components further differentiate its offerings. The company also focuses on intelligent manufacturing and sustainable development to provide competitive cost advantages and innovation-driven value.
